pairs.target: wēn xiù wǔhòu huílái , xiān ná qǐ zhuō jiǎo nà bāo méizǐ , wèn tǎ wéi shìbushì yǐjīng tì tā chī guò yíbàn .
pairs.english: When Wenxiu returned that afternoon, she picked up the plums on the table corner first and asked whether Tavi had already eaten half for her.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫午后回来，先拿起桌角那包梅子，问塔维是不是已经替她吃过一半。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhī cháng le zhǎngguì gěi de , tā tiāochū yìkē , suān dé bànshǎng méi jiǎnghuà , jiào tā xiàhuí bùfáng duō tì tā cháng yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: He said he had only tried what the shopkeeper gave him. She picked one out and went silent at its sourness for a long moment, telling him he might try a few more for her next time.
pairs.hanzi: 他说只尝了掌柜给的，她挑出一颗，酸得半晌没讲话，叫他下回不妨多替她尝一点。

pairs.target: děng tā shuō dào chuán dēng , tā cái xiào zhe ràng tā bǎ nà zhī huì bǎi de dēng wǎn huà xiàlái , bié zhī jìde dǐxià de huán .
pairs.english: Only when he mentioned the boat lamp did she smile and ask him to draw the swinging lamp bowl, not merely remember the ring underneath.
pairs.hanzi: 等他说到船灯，她才笑着让他把那只会摆的灯碗画下来，别只记得底下的环。

pairs.target: cìrì zǎoshàng , dù chéng kōng chū cèbiān yízuò búyòng de xiè jià . xiè jià bù jiē suǒ , yě bú zài huòxiāng láihuí de xiàn shàng , yìzhī jiù kōngxiāng yóu liǎnggè rén táiguòlái , wěnwěn luò zài mù dūn shàng .
pairs.english: Next morning, Du Cheng cleared an unused side unloading rack. It was not connected to the cable or on the carriage route. Two people brought an old empty crate and set it securely on wooden blocks.
pairs.hanzi: 次日早上，杜澄空出侧边一座不用的卸架。卸架不接索，也不在货厢来回的线上，一只旧空箱由两个人抬过来，稳稳落在木墩上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi mōlemō jiǎoxià de dì , cái jiāng bǎnzǐ fàngxià , zhàozhe wēn xiù dìng hǎo de cìxù jì chǐcùn .
pairs.english: Tavi felt the ground underfoot before setting down his board and recording dimensions in Wenxiu's specified order.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维摸了摸脚下的地，才将板子放下，照着温岫定好的次序记尺寸。

pairs.target: jiù xiāngdǐ sìtiáo cáo bìng bù děng kuān , qízhōng liǎngtiáo céng bèi bǔguò .
pairs.english: The old crate's four base slots were not equally wide, and two had been patched.
pairs.hanzi: 旧箱底四条槽并不等宽，其中两条曾被补过。

pairs.target: wēn xiù ná xì mùtiáo yán cáo dǐ liáng , ruǎn héng zé bǎ yǔ xiàn yòng xiè guǐ tóng kuān de mùtiáo bǎizài xiàmiàn , búràng xiāngzǐ xuán zhe , zhī zài jǐchù kěnéng jiēchù de dìfāng jiá jìn zhǐpiàn .
pairs.english: Wenxiu measured along the slot bottoms with thin wood strips. Ruan Heng placed strips as wide as the current unloading rails underneath, keeping the crate supported and inserting paper at several possible contact points.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫拿细木条沿槽底量，阮衡则把与现用卸轨同宽的木条摆在下面，不让箱子悬着，只在几处可能接触的地方夹进纸片。

pairs.target: zhǐpiàn yǒu de chōubùchū , yǒu de qīngqīng yí pèng biàn luò , jiēchù de wèizhì yìyǎn jiù néng fēnqīng .
pairs.english: Some paper could not be pulled free, while some fell at the slightest touch, making the contact positions clear at a glance.
pairs.hanzi: 纸片有的抽不出，有的轻轻一碰便落，接触的位置一眼就能分清。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuányǐwéi xiāngdǐ zhǐyào píng , tuī qǐlái biàn dōu yíyàng . rújīn tā dūnxiàqù kàn , yòubiān yìtiáo cáo qiàhǎo chī zhù guǐ biān , zuǒbiān yòu zhī yā zhe yìxiǎo jié , xiāngzǐ hái méi shòu fēng , dǐxià biàn yǐ bù ānwěn .
pairs.english: Tavi had thought any flat crate base would push the same. Crouching now, he saw a slot on the right catching the rail edge while only a short section pressed down on the left. Even without wind, the base was already unstable.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原以为箱底只要平，推起来便都一样。如今他蹲下去看，右边一条槽恰好吃住轨边，左边又只压着一小截，箱子还没受风，底下便已不安稳。

pairs.target: xiānqián nà zhī fāng xiāngdǐ miàn bùtóng , bùnéng ná tā shùnlì tōngguò , jiù shuō shì bān gōng méi tuī hǎo cháng xiāng .
pairs.english: The earlier square crate had a different base; its smooth passage was no reason to blame the porters for failing to push the long one properly.
pairs.hanzi: 先前那只方箱底面不同，不能拿它顺利通过，就说是搬工没推好长箱。

pairs.target: tā jiāng liǎngzhǒng xiāngdǐ gè huà le yìzhāng , wēn xiù kànguò , jiào tā bǎ bǔguò de dìfāng yě liúzài túlǐ .
pairs.english: He drew each kind of base separately. Wenxiu looked and told him to retain the patched areas in the drawings too.
pairs.hanzi: 他将两种箱底各画了一张，温岫看过，叫他把补过的地方也留在图里。

pairs.target: tā hé ruǎn héng shāngliáng jiā yífù néng qǔ xià de kuān tuōjià , xiān ràng xiāngzǐ wěn fàngzài tuōjià shàng , zài ràng tuōjià zài liǎngtiáo xiè guǐ jiān yídòng . cáo búbì dāngchǎng záo diào , lǎo xiāng yě búyòng yìpī quán rēng .
pairs.english: She and Ruan Heng discussed adding a removable wide cradle: secure the crate on it first, then move the cradle between the two unloading rails. The slots need not be chiseled away on the spot, nor all the old crates discarded at once.
pairs.hanzi: 她和阮衡商量加一副能取下的宽托架，先让箱子稳放在托架上，再让托架在两条卸轨间移动。槽不必当场凿掉，老箱也不用一批全扔。

pairs.target: dù chéng tīng wán , xiān wèn tuōjià yǒu duōchóng . ruò zhòng dé měi tàng yào duō lái yígè rén tái , zuìhòu háishì cóng bān gōng lǐ jiào rén , xiè guǐ shàng děng zhe , biéchù de huó yě huì gēnzhe děng .
pairs.english: Du Cheng first asked how heavy the cradle would be. If every trip needed an extra person to lift it, that person would still come from the porters, leaving the rails waiting and other work waiting too.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄听完，先问托架有多重。若重得每趟要多来一个人抬，最后还是从搬工里叫人，卸轨上等着，别处的活也会跟着等。

pairs.target: wēn xiù shuō chǐcùn hé chéngzhòng dōu dé lìng hé , yǎnxià zhī ná kōngxiāng shì xíng , bùnéng bǎ zhè yìzhāng tú zhíjiē sòng qù diào huò .
pairs.english: Wenxiu said the dimensions and load capacity needed separate checks; for now they would test the fit with an empty crate, not send this drawing straight into cargo hoisting.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫说尺寸和承重都得另核，眼下只拿空箱试形，不能把这一张图直接送去吊货。

pairs.target: wǔqián , yígè huō le bànkē ményá de bān gōng guòlái zhǎo dù chéng , shǒulǐ tí zhe qián xiē rì àn bājiàn lǐngqián de xiǎo mù qiān .
pairs.english: Before noon, a porter missing half a front tooth came for Du Cheng, holding the little wooden pay tally for eight items from a few days earlier.
pairs.hanzi: 午前，一个豁了半颗门牙的搬工过来找杜澄，手里提着前些日按八件领钱的小木签。

pairs.target: tā tīngjiàn búyòng chāi xiāng , méi xiān xiào , fǎndǎo wèn shì shuí yào tuī zhège jiàzi . dù chéng shuō hái méi dìng , tā biàn jiāng mù qiān zài zhǐ jiān zhuǎn le yìquān , shuō zìjǐ kě bùnéng xiān dāying yǐhòu dōu zhàn pángbiān .
pairs.english: Hearing there would be no unpacking, he did not smile first but asked who would push the cradle. Du Cheng said it was undecided. He turned the tally between his fingers and said he could not agree in advance to stand aside from now on.
pairs.hanzi: 他听见不用拆箱，没先笑，反倒问是谁要推这个架子。杜澄说还没定，他便将木签在指间转了一圈，说自己可不能先答应以后都站旁边。

pairs.target: " wǒ búshì búhuì tuī . " tā shuō , " wǒ shǎo chāi yìxiāng , shǎo lǐng de qián dāngtiān jiù zhīdào .
pairs.english: “It's not that I can't push,” he said. “One less crate unpacked, and I know that very day how much pay I've lost.
pairs.hanzi: “我不是不会推。”他说，“我少拆一箱，少领的钱当天就知道。

pairs.target: nǐmen shuō duō guò jǐ xiāng biàn dōu yǒu hǎochù , guò de shì shuíjiā de , qián luòdào shuí shǒu , wǒ dé děng duōjiǔ cái zhīdào ? "
pairs.english: You say more carriages through benefits everyone. Whose carriages? Whose hands does the money reach? How long must I wait to know?”
pairs.hanzi: 你们说多过几厢便都有好处，过的是谁家的，钱落到谁手，我得等多久才知道？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shǒulǐ de bǐ tíng le . tā gāng huà wán nà fù kuān tuōjià , xīnlǐ zhèng juéde zhōngyú yǒu le yìdiǎn néng zuò de shì , yì tái yǎn , què xiàng bǎ yìzhāng hǎoxiāoxī dì dào le bùgāi gāoxìng de rén miànqián .
pairs.english: Tavi's pen stopped. He had just finished drawing the wide cradle and felt he finally had something he could do; looking up, though, it was like handing good news to someone who had no reason to celebrate.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维手里的笔停了。他刚画完那副宽托架，心里正觉得终于有了一点能做的事，一抬眼，却像把一张好消息递到了不该高兴的人面前。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng shuō yěxǔ kěyǐ ràng bān gōng gǎi tuī jiàzi , huàdàozuǐbiān , yòu fāxiànzìjǐ gēnběn bù zhīdào zhèyàng yìbān gěi duōshǎo .
pairs.english: He wanted to suggest that the porters could push cradles instead, then realized he had no idea how much a shift like that paid.
pairs.hanzi: 他想说也许可以让搬工改推架子，话到嘴边，又发现自己根本不知道这样一班给多少。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng méiyǒu tì tā jiē zhège huà . tā qǐng nà rén xiàwǔ yídào lái jiēhuò fáng , bǎ yǎnxià chāizhuāng de jiànshù hé gōngqián dàishàng , zhuǎnyùn huì dāngtiān zhí shì de dǒng lǐshìhuì lái , shì jià de qián hé wǎnghòu de huó bùnéng hánhu chéng yìbǐ .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng did not answer for him. He invited the man to the receiving office that afternoon with current unpacking counts and pay. Director Dong, on duty for the association that day, would come; trial pay and future work must not be blurred together.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡没有替他接这个话。他请那人下午一道来接货房，把眼下拆装的件数和工钱带上，转运会当天值事的董理事会来，试架的钱和往后的活不能含糊成一笔。

pairs.target: xiàwǔ de wūlǐ hěnjǐ , dù chéng de fànhé zhèhuí fàngzài chuāngtáishàng .
pairs.english: The room was crowded that afternoon; Du Cheng's lunch box was on the windowsill this time.
pairs.hanzi: 下午的屋里很挤，杜澄的饭盒这回放在窗台上。

pairs.target: dǒng lǐshì shì gè chuān qīng bùyī de nǚrén , jìnmén xiān wèn tíngyùn nà yìlán yǒuméiyǒu bǎ duìàn děnghòu yě jì shàng , cái tīng tāmen jiǎng tuōjià .
pairs.english: Director Dong was a woman in blue cloth clothes. Entering, she first asked whether the stoppage column included waiting on the opposite bank before hearing about the cradle.
pairs.hanzi: 董理事是个穿青布衣的女人，进门先问停运那一栏有没有把对岸等候也记上，才听他们讲托架。

pairs.target: tā yuàn fù mùliào hé shìyòng gōngshí , què bùkěn jiùcǐ dāying suǒyǒu bān gōng yǐhòu àn bān lǐngqián , shuō jǐjiā huò xíng fēntān de búshì tóng yìzhǒng fèiyòng , xū dàihuíqù yì .
pairs.english: She would pay for wood and trial hours, but would not promise shift pay for all porters from then on. The firms shared different types of expenses, she said; she had to take it back for discussion.
pairs.hanzi: 她愿付木料和试用工时，却不肯就此答应所有搬工以后按班领钱，说几家货行分摊的不是同一种费用，须带回去议。

pairs.target: huōyá bān gōng shuō , nà yě bùnéng xiān ná shěng chūlái de shíjiān xiěchéng yǐjīng shěng xià de qián .
pairs.english: The gap-toothed porter said they could not write time saved as money already saved in advance either.
pairs.hanzi: 豁牙搬工说，那也不能先拿省出来的时间写成已经省下的钱。

pairs.target: dǒng lǐshì bǎ zhàngcè hé le yíxià , yòu chóngxīn dǎkāi , jiào jìzhàng de rén bǎ shìyòng yíxiàng lìng liè . jīnrì méiyǒu tándìng chángjiǔ de bànfǎ , zhìshǎo shuí lái shì , shì de shíhòu lǐng shénme , dé zài xiàcì tuī jià qián shuō qīngchǔ .
pairs.english: Director Dong briefly closed the ledger, then opened it again and told the bookkeeper to list trials separately. They had not settled a lasting arrangement today, but at least who would do the trial and what they would earn had to be clear before the next cradle test.
pairs.hanzi: 董理事把账册合了一下，又重新打开，叫记账的人把试用一项另列。今日没有谈定长久的办法，至少谁来试、试的时候领什么，得在下次推架前说清楚。

pairs.target: sàn hòu , tǎ wéihé ruǎn héng huídào cè xiè jià , yángguāng yǐ cóng xiāngdǐ yí dào dìshàng . tā wèn shìbushì zìjǐ huà dé tài kuài .
pairs.english: Afterward Tavi and Ruan Heng returned to the side rack; sunlight had shifted from the crate base to the ground. He asked if he had drawn too quickly.
pairs.hanzi: 散后，塔维和阮衡回到侧卸架，阳光已从箱底移到地上。他问是不是自己画得太快。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō tú zǒngděi yǒurén huà , jiào tā bǎ juàn le jiǎo de zhǐ yāpíng , bié ràng gāng huà hǎo de cáo xiàn yòu zhé chéng yìtiáo jiǎ de .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng said someone had to draw it, and told him to flatten the curled corner so his new slot lines would not acquire another false fold-line.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说图总得有人画，叫他把卷了角的纸压平，别让刚画好的槽线又折成一条假的。

pairs.target: tā chóngxīn jiāng chǐ fàngshàngqù . zhècì pángbiān duō liú le yìzhāng zhǐ , xiě de shì shuí bān , bān duōjiǔ , xiàmiàn hái kōng zhe , děng zhēn zuò guò zhīhòu zài tián .
pairs.english: He placed his ruler on it again. This time he left an extra sheet beside it for who carried and how long; the space below remained blank, to fill after they had actually done it.
pairs.hanzi: 他重新将尺放上去。这次旁边多留了一张纸，写的是谁搬、搬多久，下面还空着，等真做过之后再填。
